title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative:
The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire and partners in the Kambia, Karene and Port Loko districts of Sierra Leone, works towards the goal that poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable livelihoods and diverse food sources. This objective focuses on engaging communities to protect and enhance biodiversity/natural resources and the environment. Activities include reviving/strengthening Village Development Committees, training on agroforestry nursery development; and accompanying communities to develop and implement Community Based Adaptation interventions to guide household and community efforts in natural resource management. The principal focus of this outcome is: • Community-led management of natural resources to protect local landscapes, habitats and wild biodiversity and strengthen the resilience of communities to the ongoing impacts of climate change including the implementation of Community Environment and Climate Change Action Plans. • Integrated community-led disaster risk management processes to protect and strengthen communities’ abilities to face crises and also to protect and enhance the natural and other assets they have. • Rural Women and youth farmers, pastoralists and natural resources users.
Capacity strengthening of communities is a core element of the approach leading to stronger community structures e.g. Village Natural Resources Management Committees in which women gain leadership roles.
